packages.name: @ember-data/adapter
packages.advice: Adapters are no longer encouraged; new code should use [Handlers](/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/Handler) with the `RequestManager` from [`@warp-drive/core`](/api/@warp-drive/core/) instead.

packages.name: @ember-data/legacy-compat
packages.advice: It bridges Models, Adapters, and Serializers to the `RequestManager` and cache; new code should skip it and start from [`@warp-drive/core`](/api/@warp-drive/core/) with schemas, Handlers, and request builders.

packages.name: @ember-data/model
packages.advice: Model classes are no longer encouraged; new code should define schemas with [`@warp-drive/core`](/api/@warp-drive/core/). Apps that still need Models should install them through [`@warp-drive/legacy`](/api/@warp-drive/legacy/) rather than this package.

packages.name: @ember-data/json-api
packages.advice: New code should use [`@warp-drive/json-api`](/api/@warp-drive/json-api/) for the cache and [`@warp-drive/utilities`](/api/@warp-drive/utilities/) for the request builders instead.

packages.name: @ember-data/graph
packages.advice: It is used by the JSON:API cache; apps should not depend on it directly.

packages.name: @ember-data/serializer
packages.advice: Serializers are no longer encouraged; new code should use [Handlers](/api/@warp-drive/core/request/types/Handler) with the `RequestManager` from [`@warp-drive/core`](/api/@warp-drive/core/) instead.

packages.name: @ember-data/tracking
packages.advice: Deprecated since 5.5: the Ember reactivity bindings it provided now come from [`@warp-drive/ember`](/api/@warp-drive/ember/), so remove it and install that instead.
